description.en: Animated text effects, kinetic typography presets, and copy-paste CSS recipes.
description.zh: 收录海量动态文字特效、动力学排版预设与即拷即用的纯 CSS 文字动效配方。

content.en: Colorion Text Effects is a comprehensive creative repository of animated typography styles and copy-paste CSS/JS text effects. Ranging from neon letter glows and glitch typography to rainbow gradients and kinetic hover shifts, it supplies instant visual drama for headlines.
content.zh: Colorion Text Effects 是一座专门收录网页文本动效与文字排版创意的视觉资源库。涵盖从赛博朋克霓虹流光、故障穿梭字符（Glitch）、流动彩虹渐变到悬停物理形变等数十种纯 CSS 与微 JS 实现，支持一键复制代码，可极大丰富标题视觉表现力。
